# StackSolver UK

> StackSolver UK Limited is a Brighton-based technology consultancy for regulated industries. **Cyber security is our specialty**; around it we build **private AI, custom ERP and native GRC** — technology adapted to an organisation's processes, with governance built in rather than bolted on. **Official Claris FileMaker Partner** serving the **United Kingdom, Europe and the United States**.

**Official site:** https://www.stacksolveruk.com
**Contact:** hello@stacksolveruk.com
**Registered office:** 215 Ditchling Road, Brighton, BN1 6JD, United Kingdom
**Company Number:** 16227080

## Who we are

StackSolver UK Limited designs, builds and secures enterprise systems for organisations in regulated sectors. Cyber security is the core practice; private AI, custom ERP and compliance are built around it, so that governance, risk and compliance are not a separate bolt-on — they are engineered in.

- **Leadership:** engineering-led — 18+ years in regulated systems, CPE Cambridge C2
- **Operating languages:** English (C2)
- **Engagement model:** Remote across any time zone, on-site when the project requires it

## Services

### Cyber Security (our specialty)
Network defence, identity hardening, incident response and independent assurance for organisations that must prove their security posture.
- Page: https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services/cyber
- Includes: Cyber Essentials Plus preparation, penetration testing, Virtual CISO (vCISO), security architecture, incident response and security awareness.

### Private AI (Local-first AI)
Specialised agents (legal, financial, operational) and retrieval running on the client's own infrastructure. **Your data never leaves your perimeter** — full data residency.
- Page: https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services/ai
- Includes: private RAG, AI governance (ISO 42001), agentic AI, EU AI Act compliance and an ethical AI sandbox.
- Differentiator vs cloud LLM products: no cloud dependency, no sensitive data leakage to third parties.

### Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)
Audits, risk registers, DPO-as-a-Service and internal audit, with audit evidence designed in — not bolted on.
- Page: https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services/grc
- Frameworks delivered: ISO 27001, ISO 42001 (AI), ISO 27701 (privacy), ISO 22301, SOC 2, UK & EU GDPR — see https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services/iso-compliance
- Regulatory readiness: NIS2, DORA and third-party / supply-chain risk — see https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services/risk-resilience

### Custom ERP & Business Applications
Bespoke ERP built on **Claris FileMaker** — finance, HR, projects, operations and reporting in one tailored, auditable system you own. Migration from NetSuite and legacy systems.
- Page: https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services/erp
- Differentiator: we do not sell off-the-shelf licences. Every system is configured around the client's process.

## Coverage

We work with organisations across the **United Kingdom, Europe and the United States**, primarily in **regulated industries**: financial services, healthcare, professional services and technology.
